title: Convert the Flow Rate
text: Find the flow rate of blood using $$1\,\text{L}=1000\,\text{cm}**3$$ and $$1\, \text{min}=60\, \text{s}.$$ Give it to two decimal places (in $$\text{cm}**3/\text{s})$$.

title: Flow Rate Formula
text: Use the formula for volume flow rate: $$Q=Av, $$ where $$Q$$ is the volume flow rate, $$A$$ is the cross-sectional area, and $$v$$ is the speed of the flow.

title: Calculate the Cross-Sectional Area
text: The radius of the aorta is $$r=1.0\, \text{cm}.$$ The cross-sectional area is $$A=\pi{}r**2.$$ What is $$A$$ to two decimal places (in $$\text{cm}**2)$$?
